title: Leeman's ethnic background and family tree
summary: He describes his German, English and Indian ancestry and his family-tree research.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, what about the bands you played in -- you were of Irish descent, right? Leeman is not an Irish name, is it?
But I haven't asked you that. What is your ethnic background?
My grandfather, or my great grandfather was one of five brothers who came from Germany. I've been tracing this for two or three years now, my family tree.

And my grandfather was born up near the Canadian border, and I have the names, I can give you later. In Maine, northern Maine, he came down and met my grandmother who was born in Portland, Maine, she was a tailor. And it's a most interesting background, which I'll go over with you sometime.
